title: Megurine Luka — Here Comes The Free Spirit!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been a while since I sang that much too. Hm? Where are Rin and Len...?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Fast asleep. I guess they're all tuckered out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, these two...
KAITO, there should be a blanket towards the back of that shelf. Mind fetching it for me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
The back... Let's see... Aha, here it is!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. There we go, you two...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mhm... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I can't eat anymore...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like a lovely dream.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it does. Why don't we also take a little break? How does some coffee sound?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd like a cafe au lait today.
With some cinnamon if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I feel like a soy latte today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure, coming right up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, Miku, here's your cafe au lait. KAITO, here's your espresso latte, and a peanut soy latte for you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh, that smells wonderful♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Luka, keep it down.
Rin and Len are still sleeping.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I'm so glad that Toya and the others were able to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, wasn't seeing a real forest originally your idea, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sure, but all I did was make a small suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And this trip turned out to be full of firsts for Toya, so my hope is that he'll be able to fondly look back on everything he experienced...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh?
Are you sure that this was all about Toya?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, because I remember seeing a certain someone really cut loose and go all out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All I was trying to do was lead by example. Honest♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But I know what you mean.
Whenever I'm teaching Rin and Len something, I try to make it a fun learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I suppose that if everybody else is having fun, it's hard not to go along with them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Very true.
Maybe we should've gotten more into it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Maybe♪
Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, thinking about Toya and the others just made me realize something...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Realize what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You know how they're very impressionable and can change quite a bit after meeting someone or doing something?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if they sort of took that to heart and began looking for ways to grow on their own...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Imagine how fun it would be to see that happen!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it certainly would be.
Like seeing your own student blaze their own trail.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly! It's never a dull moment with them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can see why you guys kept such a close eye on them, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means a lot coming from you, Luka, since you're always wandering around looking for something more fun to do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha! True.
I just seem to be naturally drawn towards things or places that pique my interest.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that I'll never get bored of them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So do I. There's just something about them that makes you want to see what happens next, you know?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah, that! I mean, even KAITO seems really interested in them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean by that?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're still free to go wherever you please, Luka, and I don't want to make you feel tied down...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But would you like to stay with us awhile and see what happens to them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like it if you stayed as well, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See what happens?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
I think I'll stick around for a bit!
